title: ¿Qué es una revolución?
goal: Read the distinction between a political coup and a genuine social revolution, and understand why the Haitian Revolution (1791-1804) was likely the hemisphere's first true social revolution.
grammar: No es lo mismo... que: distinciones conceptuales

items: Explain what distinguishes a revolution from a simple change of government.
Explain why the Haitian Revolution counts as a genuine social revolution.
Describe what actually happened in most nineteenth-century Latin American "revolutions."
State why this distinction matters for understanding the coming twentieth century.
Use no es lo mismo... que to draw a sharp conceptual distinction.
